title: Re-bless scope claim 'everything else byte-identical' is false: goldens/warn.t1 moved 300 ticks (1201-1500) in 121d8a0, omitted from both scope lists
evidence: commit 121d8a0 message: 'Re-bless scope (all cause-documented): qos T1/log/PNGs (the churn fix + the mojibake), warn 65s PNG + surge PNGs + one new capture (mojibake + the T2 bracket); everything else byte-identical.' / spec change-log: 'Re-bless scope this round: qos T1/log/PNGs, warn 65s PNG, surge PNGs + one new capture — all cause-documented; everything else byte-identical.' / git diff f906725..121d8a0 -- goldens/warn.t1: '@@ -1205,303 +1205,303 @@ ticks 1500' then '-1201 6308b68800590d4a' '-1202 988d331365925301' (300 deleted + 300 added tick lines, ticks 1201-1500).
detail: The golden-discipline guard: 'existing goldens must NOT shift without cause documentation — an undocumented shift = a REAL finding (re-bless-without-proof is the trap)'. warn.t1 shifted 300 post-surge ticks; the causes (W-qos/W-pool crisis_evaluate changes) are documented, but warn.t1 itself is unnamed and the byte-identical claim is contradicted by the diff.
recommended_fix: Name goldens/warn.t1 in the re-bless scope with its cause (the crisis_evaluate lane-margin/pool-trigger fixes rippling into the warn demo's post-surge stream, ticks 1201+), or amend the 'everything else byte-identical' claim.
